messages:
Liz (CS): quick handoff for Cinderly — signed pilot (30d) started today. Main asks: SSO (SAML), VPC peering for private eval, and capacity for ~400–600 rps during peak tests. Decision-maker review in ~60 days so this is a potential renewal upsell.
Omar (Sales): contract has a one-month pilot MSA; committed to a dedicated slot during the pilot window (we promised up to 4 GPUs for burst). Billing contact is jen@if-cinderly.com.
Maya (Success Manager): flagged renewal timeline in Gainsight and added a 30/45/55d touch cadence. We should capture early engagement metrics (calls, API success rate, latency).
Priya (Support): can someone paste the sample SAML metadata and the VPC CIDR they expect? I’ll open a support runbook and set priority to high.
Liz (CS): SAML metadata from customer is attached in the email thread — I’ll drop it in the ticket. Their network team expects peer CIDR 10.24.0.0/16 and wants egress rules locked down.
Ben (Eng): noted on capacity. Two questions: 1) Are they ok with the quantized v2 model variant (lower cost) for the pilot? 2) Any custom model weights or enterprise-only prompt templates we need to pre-load?
Omar (Sales): they want parity with hosted outputs — no custom weights. Templates = a handful of system prompts for triage workflows, I can share. Quantized v2 is fine for now.
Priya (Support): opening ticket now. Ticket summary: "Cinderly pilot — SAML + VPC peering + dedicated burst capacity". Attaching network checklist and owner tags.
onboard-bot: Provisioning ticket #CS-3498 created by Priya. Initial assignees: @ben_eng, @liz_cs. ETA: 48h for VPC peering validation.
Ben (Eng): assigning eng tasks. Action items: (A) validate VPC peering (I’ll run the connectivity smoke tests), (B) stage SAML on our test IdP, (C) allocate dedicated slot and sanity-run model with quantized v2.
Liz (CS): owners: Ben — eng tasks; Priya — support ticket & logs; Maya — success metrics & cadence; Omar — customer comms. Next steps: Ben to confirm peering IPs + smoke test results, Priya to post initial ticket updates, Omar to schedule week-1 check-in with customer.
Ben (Eng): quick config for circuit test I’ll run — run from bastion: ```curl -sS https://internal-ping.redwood.net/healthz -H 'Host: cinderly-test'``` expecting 200 in <300ms.
Priya (Support): posted initial logs template in CS-3498. Please add traces if you hit anything >500ms.
Maya (Success Manager): capturing feedback loop — I’ll run a short survey after week-1 demo and feed into the customer health score. Flags: renewal risk medium (depends on pilot performance), network complexity may delay timeline.
Omar (Sales): adding Jen (billing) to the thread and confirming demo time tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Liz (CS): thanks — I’ll follow up with a short summary and owners in the ticket. If anything blocks peering, tag #eng-oncall and we’ll escalate.
